errors.text_span: с равномерно разположени етикети на всеки две години (2008, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018)
errors.evidence: The x-axis has labels for every year from 2008 to 2018, not every two years as stated.
The line for 'Oil and petroleum products' is light blue/cyan, not dark green.

errors.text_span: тя започва около 98% през 2008 г. и се движима леко надолу до около 96% през 2014 г., след което се повишава до около 97% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The values reported for the 'Oil and petroleum products' line are consistently incorrect. The line starts at approximately 94% in 2008, is around 94% in 2014, and ends around 94% in 2018, not 98%, 96%, and 97% respectively.

errors.text_span: се повишава до около 75% през 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The value for 'Natural gas' in 2012 is approximately 71%, not 75%.
The value for 'Solid fossil fuels' in 2009 dips to approximately 36%, not 38%.
The description fails to mention that the 'All products' line is visually distinct as it is thicker than the other three lines.
